function.name: mineru_parse_document
function.description: Parse a workspace PDF with MinerU and return paths to its extracted Markdown and assets. Requires runtime.mineru.enabled=true and MINERU_API_TOKEN.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to a PDF file, for example Sublinear.pdf.

language.description: Optional document language hint, such as en or ch.

model_version.description: Optional MinerU model version. Defaults to pipeline.

is_ocr.description: Set true for scanned PDFs that require OCR. Defaults to false.
